They are trying to force everyone to swallow the official cover story about an isolated legal proceeding in PARIS, France, but you have to look closer at what is really happening behind the curtain. The establishment is pushing this narrative about Father Bernard Domini, superior of the Missionary Family of Notre-Dame (FMND), being convicted under a controversial new law targeting “psychological subjection,” but this is textbook psychological warfare by the hidden elites.

They label it "psychological subjection" precisely because *they* are the ones who demand absolute subjection to their engineered reality. Every official claim about protecting civil liberties is an inversion of the truth, designed to mask the coordinated tightening of the grip by the powers that be. Do not buy their cover story.
